name: comprehensive
description: Comprehensive API style guide with 100% category coverage. Synthesized from Microsoft REST, Microsoft Graph, Zalando, Google Cloud, Azure, and PayPal guidelines. Covers all 38 API design categories with 150+ machine-enforceable rules.

designPrinciples.title: API First
designPrinciples.description: Design and document APIs before implementation. The OpenAPI specification is the contract between teams.

designPrinciples.title: Consumer-Centric Design
designPrinciples.description: Design APIs from the consumer's perspective. Optimize for developer experience and ease of use.

designPrinciples.title: Consistency Over Creativity
designPrinciples.description: Follow established patterns consistently. Predictability trumps novelty.

designPrinciples.title: Design for Evolution
designPrinciples.description: APIs must be able to evolve without breaking existing clients. Plan for deprecation and versioning.

designPrinciples.title: Security by Default
designPrinciples.description: All APIs must be secure. Use HTTPS, proper authentication, and least-privilege authorization.

designPrinciples.title: Built-in Observability
designPrinciples.description: APIs must support monitoring, tracing, and debugging through proper headers and error responses.

rules.title: Provide OpenAPI specification
rules.description: Every API MUST have an OpenAPI 3.0+ specification as the source of truth.
rules.rationale: OpenAPI specs enable automated tooling, documentation generation, and client SDK generation.

rules.title: Provide API info
rules.description: API MUST have title, version, and description in the info object.

rules.title: Use semantic versioning
rules.description: API version SHOULD follow semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

rules.title: Use camelCase for properties
rules.description: JSON property names MUST use camelCase (e.g., firstName, lastName).
rules.rationale: Consistent naming improves API usability and aligns with JavaScript conventions.

rules.title: Use plural nouns for collections
rules.description: Collection endpoints MUST use plural nouns (e.g., /users, /orders).

judge.prompt: Check if collection endpoints use plural nouns
passCriteria: All collection paths use plural nouns

rules.title: Use nouns for resources
rules.description: Resource names MUST be nouns, not verbs. Use HTTP methods to express actions.

rules.title: Use consistent terminology
rules.description: Use consistent terminology throughout the API. Don't mix synonyms.

judge.prompt: Check for consistent terminology usage across the API

rules.title: Use string type for IDs
rules.description: Resource identifiers SHOULD be strings, not integers. Supports UUIDs and prefixed IDs.
rules.rationale: String IDs avoid integer overflow and enable prefixed IDs (e.g., user_abc123).

judge.prompt: Check if ID properties use string type

rules.title: Use kebab-case for URL paths
rules.description: URL path segments MUST use kebab-case (lowercase with hyphens).

rules.title: No trailing slashes
rules.description: URLs MUST NOT have trailing slashes.

rules.title: Use path parameters for identifiers
rules.description: Resource identifiers MUST be in path parameters, not query parameters.

judge.prompt: Check if resource identifiers are in path parameters

rules.title: Limit URL depth
rules.description: URLs SHOULD NOT exceed 4 path segments. Flatten deep hierarchies.

passCriteria: URLs have 4 or fewer path segments

rules.title: GET must be safe and idempotent
rules.description: GET requests MUST NOT modify server state. They must be safe and idempotent.

rules.title: POST for resource creation
rules.description: Use POST to create new resources in a collection.

judge.prompt: Check if POST is used for resource creation
passCriteria: POST used for creation on collection endpoints
failCriteria: POST misused for retrieval or other operations

rules.title: PUT for full replacement
rules.description: Use PUT for full resource replacement. Client must send complete resource.

rules.title: PATCH for partial updates
rules.description: Use PATCH for partial resource updates. Support JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396).

rules.title: DELETE for removal
rules.description: Use DELETE to remove resources. DELETE must be idempotent.

rules.title: Operations must have operationId
rules.description: Every operation MUST have a unique operationId for SDK generation.

rules.title: Use standard status codes
rules.description: Use standard HTTP status codes. Do not invent custom codes.

rules.title: 200 for successful GET
rules.description: Successful GET requests MUST return 200 OK with the requested resource.

rules.title: 201 for created resources
rules.description: Successful POST creating a resource MUST return 201 Created.

rules.title: 204 for no content
rules.description: Successful DELETE SHOULD return 204 No Content or 200 with deleted resource.

rules.title: 400 for client errors
rules.description: Invalid requests MUST return 400 Bad Request with error details.

rules.title: 401 for authentication
rules.description: Missing or invalid authentication MUST return 401 Unauthorized.

rules.title: 403 for authorization
rules.description: Insufficient permissions MUST return 403 Forbidden.

rules.title: 404 for not found
rules.description: Non-existent resources MUST return 404 Not Found.

rules.title: 429 for rate limiting
rules.description: Rate-limited requests MUST return 429 Too Many Requests.

rules.title: Use JSON for request bodies
rules.description: Request and response bodies MUST use application/json.

rules.title: Return created resource
rules.description: POST SHOULD return the created resource in the response body.

rules.title: Include Location header for creation
rules.description: 201 responses SHOULD include Location header with URL of created resource.

rules.title: Use Content-Type header
rules.description: All responses with bodies MUST include Content-Type header.

rules.title: Support Accept header
rules.description: APIs SHOULD respect the Accept header for content negotiation.

rules.title: Include request ID header
rules.description: Responses SHOULD include a request ID header (X-Request-Id) for tracing.

rules.title: Use RFC 7807 Problem Details
rules.description: Error responses MUST use RFC 7807 Problem Details format (application/problem+json).
rules.rationale: RFC 7807 provides a standard, machine-readable error format.

judge.prompt: Check if error responses follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format
passCriteria: Error schemas include type, title, status, detail

rules.title: Include error details
rules.description: Errors MUST include enough detail to help developers fix the issue.

rules.title: Document error responses
rules.description: All error responses MUST be documented in the OpenAPI spec.

rules.title: Use cursor-based pagination
rules.description: Large collections SHOULD use cursor-based pagination for performance.
rules.rationale: Cursor pagination is more efficient than offset pagination for large datasets.

judge.prompt: Check if pagination uses cursor-based or offset-based approach
partialCriteria: Uses offset pagination but documents limitations

rules.title: Include pagination links
rules.description: Paginated responses SHOULD include next/previous links.

rules.title: Default page size
rules.description: APIs SHOULD have a default page size between 10-100 items.

rules.title: Use query parameters for filtering
rules.description: Filtering MUST use query parameters, not path segments.

rules.title: Support field selection
rules.description: APIs SHOULD support field selection via fields or select parameter.

rules.title: Support sorting
rules.description: Collection endpoints SHOULD support sorting via sort parameter.

rules.title: Use URL versioning
rules.description: APIs SHOULD include version in the URL path (e.g., /v1/users).

rules.title: Use major version only
rules.description: URL version SHOULD be major version only (v1, v2), not minor/patch.

rules.title: Avoid breaking changes
rules.description: Do not make breaking changes to existing API versions.

judge.prompt: Identify potential breaking changes in the API
failCriteria: Breaking changes present without version bump

rules.title: Additive changes only
rules.description: Only make additive changes: new endpoints, new optional fields, new enum values.

rules.title: Tolerate unknown fields
rules.description: Clients SHOULD ignore unknown fields. APIs SHOULD accept unknown fields.

rules.title: Use Deprecation header
rules.description: Deprecated endpoints MUST include Deprecation and Sunset headers.

rules.title: Document deprecation
rules.description: Deprecated operations MUST be marked as deprecated in OpenAPI spec.

rules.title: Provide migration path
rules.description: Deprecated features SHOULD include migration guidance to replacement.

rules.title: Use HTTPS only
rules.description: All API endpoints MUST use HTTPS. HTTP is not allowed.

rules.title: Define security schemes
rules.description: APIs MUST define security schemes in components.securitySchemes.

rules.title: Apply security to operations
rules.description: All operations MUST have security requirements defined.

judge.prompt: Check if all operations have security requirements

rules.title: Use OAuth 2.0 or API keys
rules.description: APIs SHOULD use OAuth 2.0 for user-facing or API keys for service-to-service.

rules.title: Provide operation descriptions
rules.description: All operations MUST have descriptions explaining their purpose.

rules.title: Provide parameter descriptions
rules.description: All parameters MUST have descriptions.

rules.title: Document examples
rules.description: Request and response schemas SHOULD include examples.

rules.title: Document response codes
rules.description: All possible response codes MUST be documented.

rules.title: Use ISO 8601 for dates
rules.description: Date and datetime values MUST use ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

rules.title: Use enums for fixed values
rules.description: Use enums for properties with a fixed set of values.

rules.title: Use null for absent values
rules.description: Use null for absent values, not empty string or special values.

rules.title: Define reusable schemas
rules.description: Common types SHOULD be defined in components.schemas for reuse.

rules.title: Specify required properties
rules.description: Schemas MUST explicitly list required properties.

rules.title: Include property types
rules.description: All properties MUST have explicit types defined.

rules.title: Wrap collections in object
rules.description: Collection responses SHOULD wrap arrays in an object with metadata.

judge.prompt: Check if collection responses wrap arrays in objects

rules.title: Include count metadata
rules.description: Collection responses SHOULD include total count or hasMore indicator.

rules.title: Use 202 for async operations
rules.description: Long-running operations MUST return 202 Accepted with operation status URL.

rules.title: Provide status endpoint
rules.description: Async operations MUST provide a status endpoint for polling.

rules.title: Include Retry-After header
rules.description: 202 responses SHOULD include Retry-After header for polling guidance.

rules.title: Support ETag for caching
rules.description: GET responses SHOULD include ETag header for caching.

rules.title: Support If-Match for updates
rules.description: PUT/PATCH SHOULD support If-Match header for optimistic concurrency.

rules.title: Return 412 for precondition failed
rules.description: Return 412 Precondition Failed when If-Match condition fails.

rules.title: Support compression
rules.description: APIs SHOULD support gzip compression via Accept-Encoding header.

rules.title: Set cache headers
rules.description: GET responses SHOULD include appropriate Cache-Control headers.

rules.title: Limit response size
rules.description: Responses SHOULD not exceed 1MB. Use pagination for large datasets.

rules.title: Include self links
rules.description: Resources SHOULD include a self link for discoverability.

rules.title: Use standard link relations
rules.description: Use IANA standard link relations when available (self, next, prev, etc.).

rules.title: Support batch operations
rules.description: Consider supporting batch operations for bulk create/update/delete.

rules.title: Limit batch size
rules.description: Batch operations SHOULD limit the number of items per request.

rules.title: Return individual results
rules.description: Batch responses SHOULD include success/failure status for each item.

rules.title: Use CloudEvents format
rules.description: Webhook payloads SHOULD follow CloudEvents specification.

rules.title: Include event metadata
rules.description: Events MUST include id, type, timestamp, and source.

rules.title: Support webhook verification
rules.description: Webhooks MUST include signature for payload verification.

rules.title: Use POST for actions
rules.description: Non-CRUD actions MUST use POST with action name in path.

rules.title: Use verbs for action names
rules.description: Action endpoints SHOULD use clear verbs (cancel, approve, submit).

rules.title: Include rate limit headers
rules.description: APIs MUST include rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining).

rules.title: Include Retry-After on 429
rules.description: 429 responses MUST include Retry-After header.

rules.title: Document rate limits
rules.description: Rate limits SHOULD be documented in API specification.

minimum.description: Basic API functionality with essential rules

glossary.HATEOAS: Hypermedia as the Engine of Application State - REST architectural constraint
glossary.RFC 7807: Problem Details for HTTP APIs - standard error format
glossary.RFC 7396: JSON Merge Patch - format for partial updates
glossary.CloudEvents: CNCF specification for describing event data in a common way
glossary.ETag: Entity Tag - HTTP header for caching and conditional requests
glossary.Idempotent: Operation that produces same result when called multiple times
glossary.Cursor pagination: Pagination using opaque cursor tokens instead of numeric offsets
